name: medium-research-discourse
description: Discourse forum research with normalized MCP output. Keyless — no credentials and no user_config: the target forum is a per-call `instance` tool parameter (scheme defaults to https), so this server hardcodes no forum host. Tools: discourse_latest, discourse_top (by period), discourse_topic. Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.
